profile.headline: Happiness is earned
profile.summary:
Proficient solution/software architect and senior software development engineer with 35 years of experience leading teams and contributing to the planning, architecture, design and development of software solutions.  I have a track record of taking projects from inception through delivery with high-quality, maintainable, robust and secure implementations.  I’m passionate about software development practice, building teams, and learning new technologies.

Specialties: Software Architecture, Solution Architecture, Microsoft Windows, Cloud Solutions
Development: C/C++, Go, SQL, JavaScript, Java, C#...
Web: HTML5, ECMAScript, Angular, Bootstrap, D3, NVD3... 
Domains: Web: Browser, Middle-tier, Database. Client: Applications, Services, Drivers, Firmware

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead on the .NET Application Performance Monitoring team that developed software that injects itself into customer web applications to monitor activities and report telemetry to the cloud-based data warehouse.  We developed primarily in C++ and C# targeting .NET Framework/Core on Windows and Linux. I was the team expert in debugging/C++/.NET profiler development/native and managed performance analysis. I worked with customers to assess defects (crash analysis, determine root cause), performance/scale issues, and product enhancement requests.

positions.title: Software Architect, Senior SDE
positions.description:
Collaboratively designed and developed a cross-platform, robust, scalable, and secure telemetry and analytics solution. Contributed/developed the following components. A user interface to inform the user of the intent to collect data and acquire consent.  A set of APIs to record telemetry and maintain a repository on the client. A background service to retrieve and apply product-specific policy to the repository forwarding desirable data to the cloud. SQL procedures to import and retrieve data for presentation (including a query facility that allowed custom queries without having to comprehend the SQL schema).  A web portal to enable authenticated users to query and visualize the data.  A collection of REST services to support access control, product dashboards and custom queries. A SAML 2.0-compliant service provider (single sign on). 

Mentored multiple Intel product teams in telemetry, data design and analysis to improve their products and tools, including: Intel Graphics Drivers/Miracast, Wireless Docking, Extreme Tuning Utility, Wireless Display, Intel Technology Access, RealSense Technology, Tamper Protect Tool, Intel Authenticate and dozens of platform and validation tools. 

Developed a Windows service to collect telemetry tracking the utilization of prototype laptops and motherboards.  By monitoring, assessing, redistributing underutilized systems, the company was able to control costs and maximize the benefit of a small number of systems.

Mentored various teams in software development, design and secure coding practices.  Taught C++, Windows debugging, multithread development, power and performance optimization and Windows® system software development best practices.  Performed secure code reviews on drivers, services and applications.

positions.title: Software Architect, Senior SDE
positions.description:
Wrote the software stack specifications for Smart Frame.  A capability of a bezel-less, detachable display to accommodate both attached and detached modes (automatically scaling the desktop and providing a black “bezel” to grip the display when detached).  

Co-designed and co-developed the Smart Frame software including firmware, drivers and system services. Vetted the solution with the internal Secure Development Lifecycle process.  Smart Frame was demoed at CES 2013.

positions.title: Software Architect, Senior SDE
positions.description:
Developed a proof of concept for multipoint video teleconferencing user experience; leveraging open source components to expedite delivery.

Developer for Intel’s Compute Continuum Framework - a vision of cross-device, cross-platform securely connected applications.  Co-developed exemplary applications: Intel Pair & Share and Intel TelePort and the CCF SDK for iOS, Android and Windows.  Collaborated in the design of CCF’s network discovery, secure protocols, and common app-device pairing user experience. 

Developed a cross-platform C++ implementation of the mDNS protocol (aka Apple Bonjour) to enable the discovery of services on the local network (printers, phones, other software services).  The code compiles on Windows, Android, and Linux and has been shipping in products for 5 years.

positions.title: Software Architect, Senior Research SDE
positions.description:
Researched and developed various proof of concept (POC) innovations leveraging the Intel Management Engine (pre-boot compute environment) including remote management and remote control of the PC.  Pre-boot discovery of other PCs on the network segment.  Remote configuration and control of BIOS settings.

Developed a CD/DVD driver that would coalesce reads into bursts of activity with gaps of inactivity to allow the system to enter low power state more frequently – effectively extending battery life.

Performed feasibility studies, developed software architecture and performed security analysis of a POC using a high-performance processor coupled with a low-performance processor sharing the same filesystem and being able to suspend one and resume the other.

positions.title: Senior Software/Solution Architect, Consultant
positions.description: Led multiple software engagements with external customers to help them realize the full benefits of Intel products and solutions.  Provided guidance and oversight to other consultants providing software development and performance optimization services to external customers. Led engagements with Marriott Corporation, Maricopa Community College District, Microsoft and others.

positions.title: Solution Architect
positions.description: Developed a software licensing solution for enterprise products and appliances.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Startup to capture, correlated, and publish crash data with then express intent to help developers assess the impact of their defects and have sufficient data to repair them.  Developed JIT and post-mordem crash analysis on client systems. Analysis results and data we forwarded to the cloud. A web portal, available to the public, summaries crash data.  Software was deployed world-wide.  ISVs licensed access to the data for their crashes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed various software components of Norton SystemWorks (suite of PC utilities).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States
positions.description: Developed Backup Exec software.  Implemented QIC and Microsoft Tape Format formatters. Wrote system software and application software to support DOS, Windows 9x, OS/2, Windows NT. Supported OEM customizations for Conner, MaynStream.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed Central Point Backup and PC Tools software products.

positions.description:
Developed firmware and test software to test IOTape tape drives for compliance with QIC standards.

Liased with Central Point Software developers to debug and improve Central Point Backup.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Implemented BIOS, firmware and drivers for custom SCSI and ATA adapters. Driver support for Windows and OS/2.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Implemented SCSI firmware for QIC and IBM 3480 tape drive.

Member of ANSI SCSI committee.

positions.description:
Implemented SCSI firmware for QIC tape drives.

Developed backup software for Windows/MS-DOS.

Member of ANSI SCSI committee.
